author: KEXP
description: Mexico City's Malcriada deliver a heavy set of hyper-punk and dark pop in our latest in-studio session. With host Albina Cabrera, the duo share a performance of "Six Seven" and more.
title: Malcriada performs "Six Seven" & more Live on KEXP
